info.name: Auto Invest Engine
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Auto Investment App. All requests go through the app-service gateway (nginx -> app-service -> {auth,portfolio}-service).

## Setup
1. Boot the stack: `docker compose up` (from `auto-invest-engine/`).
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: `http://localhost:8080`).
3. Run `Register` or `Login` first — the test script auto-saves the JWT into the `token` collection variable, which the other requests use as Bearer auth.

## Auth
JWT Bearer in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Tokens expire in 1h by default.
